info.title: Azure Migrate Platform Landing Zones Service
info.description: Azure Migrate Platform Landing Zones management API. Captures the architectural intent for an Azure Landing Zone deployment associated with a migrate project.

get.description: List the operations for the provider
List Platform Landing Zone resources under a migrate project.
Get a Platform Landing Zone resource by name.

put.description: Create or update a Platform Landing Zone resource.

Azure-AsyncOperation.description: A link to the status monitor

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

delete.description: Delete a Platform Landing Zone resource.

Location.description: The Location header contains the URL where the status of the long running operation can be checked.

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

AlzManagementGroupScope.description: Azure Landing Zone management group scope at which a policy or lock applies.

values.name: IntermediateRoot
values.description: Intermediate root management group (the ALZ root).

values.name: LandingZones
values.description: Landing zones management group (parent of Corp and Online).

Azure.ResourceManager.ResourceProvisioni.description: The provisioning state of a resource type.

dnsProxyEnabled.description: Whether DNS Proxy is enabled on the firewall.

tlsInspectionEnabled.description: Whether TLS inspection is enabled. Requires the Premium SKU.

values.name: Premium
values.description: Premium SKU. Required for TLS inspection and IDPS.

applicationInsightsEnabled.description: Whether Application Insights is provisioned in the management subscription.

enabled.description: Whether centralized backup is enabled for the landing zone.

softDeleteRetentionInDays.description: Soft-delete retention in days for the recovery services vault.

scaleUnits.description: Number of scale units. Only valid when sku is Standard or Premium; ignored for Basic.

values.name: Standard
values.description: Standard SKU. Required when scale units are specified.

Connectivity.description: Network connectivity configuration for the landing zone.

topology.description: Connectivity topology. When ManagementOnly is selected, per-service sub-blocks (firewall, bastion, ddosProtection, privateDns, vpnGateway, expressRoute) should be omitted.

internetEgress.description: Internet egress model for spoke traffic.

vpnGateway.description: VPN Gateway configuration. Discriminator value must equal Connectivity.topology.

expressRoute.description: ExpressRoute configuration. Discriminator value must equal Connectivity.topology.

ConnectivityTopology.description: Top-level connectivity topology that the landing zone deploys against.

values.name: HubAndSpoke
values.description: Classic hub-and-spoke topology built on Virtual Network peering.

values.name: ManagementOnly
values.description: Management-only landing zone with no platform-managed network connectivity. Per-service connectivity sub-blocks are omitted in this mode.

CostManagement.description: Cost management configuration for the landing zone.

budgets.description: Budgets configured on the landing zone.

CustomerManagedKeyConfig.description: Customer-managed key configuration for platform service encryption.

keyVaultId.description: Key Vault resource id holding the encryption key.

keyVersion.description: Key version. Omit for auto-rotation to the latest version.

DedicatedPlatformSubscriptions.description: Dedicated subscription model: each platform function uses its own subscription.

identity.description: Subscription that hosts the identity platform.

connectivity.description: Subscription that hosts the connectivity platform.

management.description: Subscription that hosts the management platform.

DefenderPlanName.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan identifier.

DefenderPlanSetting.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan setting.

DefenderPlanTier.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan tier.

DomainServicesConfig.description: Domain Services configuration. Required when IdentityConfig.provider is EntraIdWithDomainServices or HybridAdDs.

domainName.description: Fully qualified DNS domain name, for example "contoso.local".

subnetAddressPrefix.description: CIDR for the subnet hosting domain controllers or Azure AD Domain Services.

customerManagedKeyEnabled.description: Whether customer-managed keys are used. When false, Microsoft-managed keys are used.

customerManagedKey.description: Customer-managed key configuration. Required when customerManagedKeyEnabled is true.

ExistingSubscriptionRef.description: Reference to an existing Azure subscription used by the landing zone.

ExpressRouteConfig.description: ExpressRoute configuration. Available shapes are selected by the topology discriminator and gated by Connectivity.topology.

topology.description: Topology this ExpressRoute configuration applies to.

FirewallConfig.description: Hub firewall configuration. The deployed firewall is selected by the discriminator "kind".

FirewallKind.description: Firewall kind deployed at the hub.

values.name: ThirdPartyNva
values.description: Third-party Network Virtual Appliance. The PLZ resource captures the design intent; deployment of the NVA itself is the customer's responsibility.

Governance.description: Governance configuration for the landing zone.

policyAssignmentOverrides.description: Per-assignment overrides applied on top of the ALZ baseline. Only relevant when policyAssignmentMode is AlzDefaults.

resourceLocks.description: Resource Manager locks applied at ALZ management group scopes.

HubAndSpokeExpressRouteConfig.description: ExpressRoute Gateway configuration for hub-and-spoke topology.

fastPathEnabled.description: Whether FastPath is enabled. Requires the UltraPerformance SKU or higher.

HubAndSpokeVpnGatewayConfig.description: VPN Gateway configuration for hub-and-spoke topology (deploys an Azure VPN Gateway in the hub).

activeActive.description: Whether the VPN Gateway is active-active.

IdentityConfig.description: Identity configuration for the landing zone.

domainServices.description: Domain Services configuration. Required when provider is EntraIdWithDomainServices or HybridAdDs; ignored when provider is EntraIdOnly.

IdentityProvider.description: Identity provider strategy for the landing zone.

values.name: EntraIdWithDomainServices
values.description: Microsoft Entra ID with Azure AD Domain Services for legacy workloads.

values.name: HybridAdDs
values.description: Hybrid identity with on-premises Active Directory Domain Services synchronized via Microsoft Entra Connect.

InternetEgressModel.description: Egress model for spoke traffic destined for the internet.

values.name: ViaHub
values.description: Egress flows through the hub (Azure Firewall or third-party NVA based on FirewallConfig.kind).

values.name: DirectFromSpoke
values.description: Spoke egresses directly to the internet without traversing the hub.

rbacAuthorizationEnabled.description: Whether RBAC authorization is enabled (required for ALZ baseline).

values.name: Premium
values.description: Premium SKU vault. Required for HSM-backed software keys.

values.name: ManagedHsm
values.description: Managed HSM. A separate Managed HSM resource is provisioned.

dailyQuotaGb.description: Daily ingestion quota in GB. -1 indicates unlimited; only meaningful with the PerGB2018 SKU.

capacityReservationGbPerDay.description: Capacity reservation level in GB per day. Required when sku is CapacityReservation.

Management.description: Management plane configuration for the landing zone.

recoveryServicesVault.description: Shared Recovery Services vault used by backup and site recovery.

MigrateProject.description: A Migrate project Resource. Defined locally as the parent for PlatformLandingZone; the canonical resource is owned by the sibling Microsoft.Migrate TypeSpec projects.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

MigrateProjectProperties.description: Properties of a migrate project. Minimal stub used solely to anchor PlatformLandingZone as a child resource; the full property set is defined by the sibling Microsoft.Migrate TypeSpec projects.

NvaVendor.description: Third-party Network Virtual Appliance vendor recorded in the design.

values.name: Other
values.description: Other vendor not in the predefined list.

PlatformLandingZone.description: Platform Landing Zone resource. Captures the architectural intent for an Azure Landing Zone deployment associated with a migrate project.

properties.description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

PlatformLandingZoneBudget.description: Budget configured on the landing zone.

amount.description: Monthly budget amount in billing currency.

notificationEmails.description: Email addresses notified when budget thresholds are crossed.

thresholds.description: Thresholds in percent (0-1000) of the budget amount at which notifications fire.

PlatformLandingZoneListResult.description: The response of a PlatformLandingZone list operation.

value.description: The PlatformLandingZone items on this page

nextLink.description: The link to the next page of items

PlatformLandingZoneProperties.description: Properties of a Platform Landing Zone. This envelope is grown incrementally as sub-blocks are introduced.

identity.description: Identity configuration for the landing zone.

regions.description: Azure regions included in the landing zone design.

provisioningState.description: Provisioning state of the Platform Landing Zone resource.

PlatformRegion.description: An Azure region included in the landing zone design.

role.description: Role of this region within the landing zone.

addressSpace.description: Address space allocated to platform services in this region.

availabilityZones.description: Availability zones in this region that the landing zone targets, for example ["1","2","3"]. Empty when the region does not support availability zones or zonal deployment is not desired.

PlatformSubscriptionModel.description: Subscription model for platform-tier workloads in the landing zone.

values.name: Dedicated
values.description: Each platform function (identity, connectivity, management) uses its own dedicated subscription.

values.name: Shared
values.description: All platform functions share a single platform subscription.

PlatformSubscriptions.description: Platform subscription topology. The concrete shape is selected by the discriminator "subscriptionModel".

values.name: AlzDefaults
values.description: Apply the canonical Azure Landing Zone policy initiative as defined by Azure/alz-terraform-accelerator.

values.name: None
values.description: Do not deploy any platform policy assignments.

PolicyAssignmentOverride.description: Override of a single ALZ policy assignment.

assignmentName.description: Display name of the ALZ policy assignment being overridden.

values.name: Default
values.description: Policies are evaluated and resources in violation are recorded as non-compliant. Effects such as deny are enforced.

values.name: DoNotEnforce
values.description: Policies are evaluated but effects are not enforced. Useful for testing.

privateLinkZonesEnabled.description: Whether Azure Private DNS zones for Private Link are deployed in the connectivity subscription.

customZones.description: Additional custom Private DNS zones to deploy, e.g. ["contoso.internal"].

RecoveryServicesVault.description: Recovery Services vault configuration. Hoisted to the management block so it can be shared by Backup and Site Recovery.

crossRegionRestoreEnabled.description: Whether cross-region restore is enabled. Requires GeoRedundant redundancy.

RegionAddressSpace.description: Address space allocated to platform services in a given region.

hub.description: Address space allocated for hub virtual networks in this region, in CIDR notation.

spoke.description: Address space allocated for spoke virtual networks in this region, in CIDR notation.

RegionRole.description: Role of an Azure region within the landing zone.

values.name: Primary
values.description: Primary region. Hosts the authoritative copies of platform services.

values.name: Secondary
values.description: Secondary region. Used for paired services such as disaster recovery.

RequiredTag.description: Required tag definition enforced via policy.

defaultValue.description: Default value to apply when the tag is missing. Omit to require explicit specification on each resource.

values.name: None
values.description: Do not purchase reservations as part of the landing zone.

values.name: StableWorkloadsOnly
values.description: Purchase reservations to cover stable, predictable workloads only.

values.name: Aggressive
values.description: Aggressive reservation coverage across all workloads.

values.name: CanNotDelete
values.description: CanNotDelete: authorized users can read and modify but not delete.

values.name: ReadOnly
values.description: ReadOnly: authorized users can read only.

ResourceLockPolicy.description: Resource Manager lock applied at an ALZ management group scope.

scope.description: Management group scope the lock applies to.

notes.description: Reason for the lock, surfaced to users attempting a denied operation.

values.name: None
values.description: Do not purchase savings plans as part of the landing zone.

Security.description: Security configuration for the landing zone.

defenderPlans.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan settings.

keyVault.description: Key Vault configuration for the landing zone.

enabled.description: Whether Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on the management Log Analytics workspace.

dataConnectors.description: Names of Sentinel data connectors to enable.

SharedPlatformSubscriptions.description: Shared subscription model: a single subscription hosts all platform functions.

platform.description: Subscription that hosts all platform functions.

enabled.description: Whether Site Recovery is enabled for the landing zone.

ThirdPartyNvaFirewallConfig.description: Third-party Network Virtual Appliance configuration. The PLZ resource records the design intent; deployment of the NVA itself is the customer's responsibility.

vendor.description: Third-party NVA vendor recorded in the design.

subnetAddressPrefix.description: Subnet CIDR allocated to the NVA in the hub.

values.name: GeoRedundant
values.description: Geo redundant storage. Required to enable cross-region restore.

VirtualWanExpressRouteConfig.description: ExpressRoute configuration for Virtual WAN topology.

scaleUnits.description: Scale units for the vWAN ExpressRoute Gateway.

VirtualWanVpnGatewayConfig.description: VPN Gateway configuration for Virtual WAN topology (deploys a vWAN VPN Gateway in the virtual hub).

scaleUnits.description: Scale units for the vWAN VPN Gateway.

VpnGatewayConfig.description: VPN Gateway configuration. Available shapes are selected by the topology discriminator and gated by Connectivity.topology.

topology.description: Topology this VPN configuration applies to.
